q: How many customers do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

q: Which countries have the most customers?
sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY 2 DESC

q: Customer count by segment
sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY segment

q: What are the top 3 product categories by revenue?
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status<>'cancelled' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

q: Total revenue
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status<>'cancelled'

q: Total profit
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*(oi.unit_price-p.cost)) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status<>'cancelled'

q: How many orders were cancelled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled'

q: Order count by status
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

q: What is the cancellation rate by customer segment?
sql: SELECT c.segment, AVG((o.status='cancelled')::int) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY 1

q: Top 5 customers by revenue
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status<>'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

q: Revenue by country
sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status<>'cancelled' GROUP BY 1

q: Average order value
sql: SELECT AVG(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) t FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status<>'cancelled' GROUP BY o.id) x

q: How many products are in each category?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category

q: Most expensive product
sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which product has the highest margin percentage?
sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY (price-cost)/price DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many active customers were there last month?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.status<>'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - interval '1 month') AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)

q: Show monthly revenue for the last 12 months
sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status<>'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '11 months' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

q: How many customers signed up per year?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM signup_date), COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

q: Customers who never placed an order
sql: SELECT c.id FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.id)

q: Return rate by product category
sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FILTER (WHERE o.status='returned')::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id GROUP BY 1

q: Which segment has the highest average order value?
sql: SELECT segment FROM (SELECT c.segment, AVG(t) a FROM (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) t FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status<>'cancelled' GROUP BY o.id, o.customer_id) x JOIN customers c ON c.id=x.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1) y
